texts: There is a slight male predominance in HLHS: B.
About 55 to 65 percent of affected infants are boys.
Before modern surgery HLHS caused about a quarter of cardiac deaths in the first week of life.
Chromosomal abnormalities are found in around 10 percent, Turner syndrome being among the commonest, and the recurrence risk for a sibling is a few percent.
